# Bullhead Hotel & Butchery, Emali

> Bullhead is a 24-hour butchery and hotel (restaurant) on the Nairobi–Mombasa road in Emali, Makueni County, Kenya. Customers can browse the menu, build a plate and send the order to WhatsApp.

## Pages
- [Home](https://bullheadhotels.co.ke/): overview
- [Menu](https://bullheadhotels.co.ke/menu): cuts, plates and prices
- [Visit](https://bullheadhotels.co.ke/visit): location, map and opening hours (open 24 hours)
- [Contact](https://bullheadhotels.co.ke/contact): WhatsApp and phone
- [Gallery](https://bullheadhotels.co.ke/gallery): photos

## Contact
- WhatsApp / phone: +254 720 707 323
